cohort: 244,336 women who gave birth between 2006 and 2020 in the French Burgundy Perinatal Network, including 237,608 naturally conceived pregnancies, 1,773 fresh-IVF pregnancies, and 878 frozen-IVF pregnancies
finding: Frozen-IVF pregnancies have a higher risk of major postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) compared to both naturally conceived pregnancies and fresh-IVF pregnancies.
mod_finding: The study adjusted for mode of delivery as a confounder but did not examine the effect of different modes of delivery on postpartum haemorrhage.
